# ASW parser mock data added

Implemented mock parsing layer for agent, skill, workflow, task, and changelog assets.

## Why

The ASW Observatory needs to parse real markdown files with YAML frontmatter instead of relying on hardcoded in-memory data.

## Changed

- Added `FrontmatterParser` for generic YAML frontmatter decoding
- Added `WorkspaceMarkdownParser` for asset-specific parsing
- Created test fixtures for all five asset families
- Added parser tests covering happy-path and malformed inputs

## Evidence

- `test/data/parsers/workspace_markdown_parser_test.dart` — all tests pass
- `test/fixtures/mock_workspace/` — representative fixture files
